notes.title: Guncar Arena
notes.notes: Fight off the alien invasion in Guncar Arena! A thrilling, fast-paced survivor shooter combining roguelite elements, vehicular combat and over-the-top upgrades. Customize your car with powerful weapons and items to become an unstoppable engine of destruction!

notes.title: Guncar Arena gameplay
notes.notes: Witness the explosive action firsthand in this livestream event featuring the game's adrenaline-fueled gameplay. Get ready to blast your way through alien hordes and upgrade your car to maximum destruction. Don't miss this opportunity to join the fight against the alien invasion!
